gaps.sentence: I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
Hold ___ a moment — I'll check if he's in.
gaps.explanation: hold on = wait (especially on the phone).

gaps.sentence: The chairman walked ___ of the meeting when the press arrived.
gaps.explanation: 'Walk out of' = leave suddenly, often to show disapproval.

gaps.sentence: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
